::: {.cell context='setup' autorun='false'}

```{.webr .cell-code}
download.file(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emzou/r-guide/main/datasets/titanic.csv",
  "titanic.csv"
)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
df <- read_csv("titanic.csv")
```
:::




# Central Tendency Measures 
`Sex` is a nominal variable
`Pclass` is an ordinal variable 
`Age` is an interval variable

## Mode 



::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
mode(df$Sex, na.rm = TRUE) 
mode(df$Pclass, na.rm = TRUE) 
mode(df$Age, na.rm = TRUE) 
```
:::




## Median



::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
mode(df$Pclass, na.rm = TRUE) 
mode(df$Age, na.rm = TRUE) 
```
:::




## Quartiles



::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
summary(df$Pclass, na.rm = TRUE) 
summary(df$Age, na.rm = TRUE) 
```
:::




## Mean



::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
mean(df$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
```
:::




# Measures of spread

##  Range 



::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
range(df$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
```
:::




## Interquartile Range



::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
iqr(df$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
```
:::




##  Standard Deviation



::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
sd(df$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
```
:::




## Variance



::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
var(df$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
```
:::




# Boxplot 
A boxplot is another way to display the measures of spread at once. It summarizes a variable's distribution by showing its median, quartiles, and spread, with outliers plotted individually.




::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
ggplot(df, aes(y = df$Age)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
:::




### Horizontal Box Plot
You can display a horizontal box plot instead of a vertical one by changing the "y =" call in aes() to "x =". Change it in the code block above and see how the visual changes. 


## Improving Readability 



::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
ggplot(df, aes(y = df$Age)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "steelblue",
    alpha = 0.7,
    width = 0.4,
    outlier.color = "grey30",
    outlier.alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution of Titanic Passengers ",
    y = "Age"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```
:::
